name: integration-metadata-core-dtos-wave17-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: Metadata.AsyncResult, Metadata.ConsoleComponent, and Metadata.CustomField are deterministic Glade-local DTO contracts; Salesforce API 67 does not provide hosted parity for these rows.

source.content: Metadata.AsyncResult asyncResult = new Metadata.AsyncResult(); asyncResult.done = true; asyncResult.id = '0Af000000000001AAA'; asyncResult.message = 'Completed'; asyncResult.state = 'Succeeded'; asyncResult.statusCode = Metadata.StatusCode.APEX_FAILED; System.assertEquals(true, asyncResult.done); System.assertEquals('0Af000000000001AAA', asyncResult.id); System.assertEquals('Completed', asyncResult.message); System.assertEquals('Succeeded', asyncResult.state); System.assertEquals('APEX_FAILED', String.valueOf(asyncResult.statusCode)); Metadata.ConsoleComponent console = new Metadata.ConsoleComponent(); console.height = 200; console.location = 'UtilityBar'; console.visualforcePage = 'Page.Home'; console.width = 640; Metadata.ConsoleComponent clone = (Metadata.ConsoleComponent)console.clone(); System.assertEquals(200, clone.height); System.assertEquals('UtilityBar', clone.location); System.assertEquals('Page.Home', clone.visualforcePage); System.assertEquals(640, clone.width); System.assertNotEquals(console, clone); Metadata.CustomField custom = new Metadata.CustomField(); custom.description = 'Invoice paid'; custom.fullName = 'Invoice__c.Paid__c'; custom.label = 'Paid'; custom.required = true; custom.type = 'Checkbox'; custom.unique = true; System.assertEquals('Invoice paid', custom.description); System.assertEquals('Invoice__c.Paid__c', custom.fullName); System.assertEquals('Paid', custom.label); System.assertEquals(true, custom.required); System.assertEquals('Checkbox', custom.type); System.assertEquals(true, custom.unique);
